act: AIFC Conduct of Business Rules (COB), V17

en.title: COB 13.2.10 heading in the consolidated texts and online reads "Principle 8 ‐ Client Money and Client Assets"; Amendments No. 11 inserted "Principle 10 – Complaints"
en.summary: Amendments No. 11 (in force 1 January 2024) inserted COB 13.2.9 "Principle 9 ‐ Conflicts of interest" and 13.2.10 "Principle 10 – Complaints"; the amending instrument shows both headings as new text. The consolidated versions V12 to V17 on aifc.kz and the AFSA online COB show 13.2.10 under the heading "Principle 8 ‐ Client Money and Client Assets", which is the heading of 13.2.8. The rulebook therefore has two "Principle 8" headings and no Principle 10. The text of 13.2.10 itself (complaints) is correct.
en.correction: Please restore the heading "13.2.10. Principle 10 – Complaints", as made by Amendments No. 11, in the consolidated text on aifc.kz and in the AFSA online COB. A heading is part of the act (section 24(1)(a) of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts).
